<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/organizations/{organizationId}/users"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Creates credentials for SFTP, FTPS, the web portal and the S3-compatible endpoint.

Every field is optional. An empty body creates credentials with a generated name and password, a
home directory of `/home/{UserName}` and `Permission: none`: they can connect but can't see any
files. Set `Permission`, or give them virtual folders with `HomeDirectoryDetails`.

The response includes the password. You can read it again later by retrieving the credentials.

Counts against your plan's limit on credentials.


:::info

Counts against your plan's credentials limit. Read more about our different plans [here](https://sftptogo.com/pricing).

:::
